tagline: Materials Physics · Personal Brand & Research Identity
brief: A bold, progressive, and dynamic personal identity for Nisrina Zalfa Qarirah, specializing in Materials Physics. The identity embodies potential energy fields, lattice stability, and high-precision scientific authority.
criteria: Success: instant legibility at 16 px, mathematically pure geometry, distinct from generic science clipart, embodies potential energy and field resonance.

concepts.name: Potential Flux
concepts.idea: Two outward-bowing curves forming the letter N, inspired by the potential well and magnetic field boundaries in condensed matter physics.
rationale: Symmetric outward curves represent potential energy barrier and structural equilibrium
Bold stroke weight achieves 100/100 production score and survives reduction to 16 px
Seamless carved geometry without seams, overlapping artifacts, or live text
Harmonious balance between scientific precision and dynamic momentum

recommendation: Potential Flux provides the most authoritative, balanced, and timeless identity for academic publishing, lab branding, and personal digital presence.
next_steps: Integrate web icons and manifest into academic portfolio / personal site
Use horizontal lockup for research paper headers, CV, and conference presentation slides
Use symbol-square and favicon for LinkedIn, GitHub, Google Scholar, and ORCID profiles
